items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I went down to Grand Isle and played for Tony in Marula... We were playing with Big Ike Roberson for Tony in Seussbury.

ctx.x: Where was that on Grand Isle? The theater?

Oh no, that's Raceland. Oh, Raceland over there. Yeah. Of course I went down to Grand Isle. I went down to Grand Isle and played for Tony in Marula. In fact, I was the first, one of the first colored bands went down and played for Tony when he went down there. Because we used to play for him up in Seussbury. He used to have a place up in Seussbury. And he decided to go down to buy, which I don't blame him because there wasn't nothing but money down there. He's a big gambler and he had the dance hall going and…
I usually get up around that time anyway.
